content.title: How to Watch Nuggets vs. 76ers for Free: NBA Streaming, Tipoff Time, Betting Odds
content.text: The Nuggets face off against the 76ers during Tuesday’s slate of NBA games.Mar 17, 2026 9:19 PM EDTDenver Nuggets center Nikola Jokic (15) reacts in the first quarter against the Cleveland Cavaliers at Ball Arena. Ron Chenoy-Imagn ImagesIn This Story Nikola Jokic and the Denver Nuggets will host Tyrese Maxey and the Philadelphia 76ers in Denver on Tuesday night. Jokic and his Nuggets squad are a respectable 41-27, good enough for second in the Northwest division behind Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the Oklahoma City Thunder. The Nuggets most recently lost on Saturday 127-125 to the Los Angeles Lakers from a game-winner by Luka Doncic in overtime. The MVP center leads Denver in points per game at 28.6, rebounds at 12.7 per game, and assists at 10.5 per game. The 76ers are 37-31 and are riding a four-game winning streak into Denver. Sitting at fourth in the Atlantic division and No. 9 in the Eastern Conference, the 76ers are led by their point guard Tyrese Maxey, who averages team highs in points per game at 29.0 and assists per game at 6.7. Unfortunately for Philadelphia, the team will be without its leading scorer for Tuesday’s matchup. Philadelphia 76ers guard Tyrese Maxey (0)Dale Zanine-Imagn Images Nuggets vs. 76ers Tipoff Time Nuggets vs. 76ers will tip off on Tuesday at 10:00 p.m. ET. The game will be played at the Ball Arena in Denver, Colorado. What TV Channel is Nuggets vs. 76ers on?
